metadata.title: Midterm Summative Assessment (PSTS) — Physics
metadata.konstanta: k = 9 x 10^9 N.m^2/C^2 kecuali dinyatakan lain; sudut istimewa: 30 deg, 37 deg, 45 deg, 53 deg, 60 deg, 90 deg
metadata.catatan_matematika: Level matematika: aljabar dasar, perbandingan/proporsi, trigonometri sudut istimewa (vektor gaya & medan). TIDAK memuat limit, integral, diferensial, atau matriks.
instruksi: Bacalah setiap soal dengan teliti sebelum menjawab.
Gunakan k = 9 x 10^9 N.m^2/C^2 kecuali dinyatakan lain pada soal.
Untuk soal Pilihan Ganda Kompleks (MCMA), jawaban benar HANYA jika seluruh pilihan yang tepat dipilih (tanpa kurang atau lebih).
Untuk soal Benar/Salah, jawablah setiap pernyataan berdasarkan paragraf stimulus di atasnya.
Tidak ada pengurangan nilai untuk jawaban salah (no negative marking).

soal.pertanyaan: Two point charges, \( q_1 = +2\ \mu C \) and \( q_2 = +8\ \mu C \), are separated by a distance of 0.3 m in vacuum. Determine the magnitude of the electrostatic force between them. (\( k = 9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \))
If both point charges in a Coulomb's Law setup are tripled while the distance between them is doubled, what happens to the magnitude of the electrostatic force?

opsi.C: It becomes 0.44 times the original value.

soal.pertanyaan: Two point charges, \( +Q \) and \( +4Q \), are fixed 0.6 m apart along a straight line. At what distance from the \( +Q \) charge (measured along the line, between the two charges) must a third charge be placed so that the net electrostatic force acting on it is zero?

Two equal electrostatic forces, each with a magnitude of 10 N, act on a charged particle. The angle between the two forces is \( 60^{\circ} \). Determine the magnitude of the resultant force. (Use \( \cos 30^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\sqrt{3} \))

A point charge experiences an electrostatic force of 20 N directed at \( 37^{\circ} \) above the horizontal axis. Determine the magnitude of the horizontal (x) component of this force. (\( \sin 37^{\circ}=0.6,\ \cos 37^{\circ}=0.8 \))
A point charge \( Q = +5\ \mu C \) is located in vacuum. Determine the magnitude of the electric field at a point 0.5 m away from the charge. (\( k = 9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \))

Two point charges of equal magnitude each produce an electric field of \( 8\times10^{4} \) N/C at point P, with the two field vectors perpendicular to one another (angle of \( 90^{\circ} \) between them). Determine the magnitude of the resultant electric field at point P.

A point charge \( +Q \) and a point charge \( -4Q \) are placed 0.9 m apart. At what distance from the \( +Q \) charge, measured outward along the line joining the two charges (on the side of \( +Q \), away from \( -4Q \)), is the total electric field equal to zero?
A region of space contains electric field lines that are straight, parallel, and equally spaced throughout that region. What can be concluded about the electric field in that region?

opsi.A: The field is uniform in both magnitude and direction.
opsi.B: The field magnitude increases along the direction of the lines.
opsi.C: The field is zero everywhere in that region.
opsi.D: The field lines indicate a radial (point-charge) field.

soal.pertanyaan: A flat surface with an area of 0.02 m\(^2\) is placed in a uniform electric field of \( 5\times10^{3} \) N/C. The normal to the surface makes an angle of \( 60^{\circ} \) with the field direction. Determine the electric flux through the surface. (\( \cos 60^{\circ}=0.5 \))
According to Gauss's Law, the total electric flux through any closed surface depends only on which of the following?

opsi.A: The shape of the closed surface.
opsi.B: The net electric charge enclosed by the surface.
opsi.C: The total surface area of the closed surface.
opsi.D: The distance between the surface and the nearest charge.

soal.pertanyaan: A closed spherical surface encloses a net charge of \( +4\times10^{-9} \) C. Given \( \varepsilon_0 = 8.85\times10^{-12}\ \text{C}^2/\text{N·m}^2 \), determine the total electric flux through the surface.
Determine the electric potential at a point located 0.2 m from a point charge of \( +6\ \mu C \). (\( k = 9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \))
Two point charges, \( +3\ \mu C \) and \( -2\ \mu C \), are separated by 0.1 m. Calculate the electric potential energy of this two-charge system. (\( k = 9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \))
How much work is required to move a \( +4 \) C charge from a point where the electric potential is 15 V to a point where the potential is 40 V?
Two identical point charges, each \( +Q = +2\ \mu C \), are placed 0.4 m apart. Determine the electric potential at the midpoint between them. (\( k = 9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \))
Which of the following statements about equipotential surfaces is correct?

opsi.A: Work done moving a charge along an equipotential surface is always positive.
opsi.B: Two equipotential surfaces belonging to the same charge distribution can intersect each other.
opsi.C: Electric field lines are always perpendicular to equipotential surfaces.
opsi.D: The electric potential always increases as you move along an equipotential surface.

soal.pertanyaan: The electric potential difference between two parallel plates separated by 4 cm is 200 V. Assuming the field between the plates is uniform, determine the magnitude of the electric field between the plates.
A solid conducting sphere carries a net positive charge and is isolated in space, in electrostatic equilibrium. Which statement about its surface is correct?

opsi.A: The surface of the conductor is an equipotential surface.
opsi.B: The potential varies from point to point on the surface.
opsi.C: The electric field lines run tangent to (along) the surface.
opsi.D: The potential at the surface is always zero.

soal.pertanyaan: A charge of 5 C moves along an equipotential surface from point A to point B. How much work is done by the electric force during this displacement?

opsi.C: Equal to the product of the charge and the distance travelled.
opsi.D: It depends on the path taken between A and B.

soal.pertanyaan: A parallel-plate capacitor has capacitance \( C \). If the plate separation is reduced to \( \tfrac{1}{4} \) of its original value while the plate area is kept constant, what is the new capacitance, expressed in terms of \( C \)?

A parallel-plate capacitor with vacuum between its plates has a capacitance of 4 \( \mu \)F. A dielectric material with relative permittivity \( \varepsilon_r = 5 \) is then inserted, completely filling the gap between the plates. Determine the new capacitance.
Two capacitors, 6 \( \mu \)F and 3 \( \mu \)F, are connected in series. Calculate the equivalent capacitance of this combination.
Two capacitors, 6 \( \mu \)F and 3 \( \mu \)F, are connected in parallel. Calculate the equivalent capacitance of this combination.

In a circuit, a 4 \( \mu \)F capacitor is connected in parallel with a 2 \( \mu \)F capacitor. This parallel combination is then connected in series with a 6 \( \mu \)F capacitor. Determine the total equivalent capacitance of the whole circuit.
A capacitor with a capacitance of 2 \( \mu \)F is charged to a potential difference of 100 V. Determine the electric energy stored in the capacitor. (\( W=\tfrac{1}{2}CV^2 \))
A 5 \( \mu \)F capacitor is connected to a 12 V battery. Determine the magnitude of the charge stored on each plate.

An isolated parallel-plate capacitor (disconnected from any battery) has an initial capacitance of 2 \( \mu \)F and is charged to 50 V. A dielectric with \( \varepsilon_r = 4 \) is then inserted, completely filling the space between the plates. Determine the new voltage across the capacitor.

A parallel-plate capacitor remains connected to a battery that maintains a constant voltage. If the plate area is doubled while the plate separation stays the same, what happens to the charge stored on the capacitor?

opsi.A: It becomes half of the original value.
opsi.C: It becomes twice the original value.
opsi.D: It becomes four times the original value.

soal.pertanyaan: Two identical 4 \( \mu \)F capacitors are connected to a 10 V battery. Determine the ratio of the total energy stored when the two capacitors are connected in parallel (\( W_{parallel} \)) to when they are connected in series (\( W_{series} \)), i.e. \( W_{parallel} : W_{series} \).
Consider the Coulomb's Law equation \( F = k\dfrac{q_1 q_2}{r^2} \). Which of the following statements are correct? (Select exactly 3 correct answers)

opsi.1: The force is directly proportional to the product of the two charges.
opsi.2: The force is directly proportional to the square of the distance.
opsi.3: The force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance.
opsi.4: If the distance between the charges is doubled, the force becomes four times smaller.
opsi.5: The force does not depend at all on the medium between the charges.

soal.pertanyaan: Which of the following statements about a solid conductor in electrostatic equilibrium are correct? (Select exactly 3 correct answers)

opsi.1: The electric field inside the conducting material is zero.
opsi.2: Any excess charge resides entirely on the outer surface of the conductor.
opsi.3: Electric field lines are perpendicular to the surface just outside the conductor.
opsi.4: The electric potential varies from the center to the surface of the conductor.
opsi.5: The surface of the conductor is not an equipotential surface.

soal.pertanyaan: A dielectric material is inserted between the plates of an isolated, fully-charged parallel-plate capacitor (disconnected from the battery). Which of the following statements about the resulting changes are correct? (Select exactly 3 correct answers)

opsi.1: The capacitance of the capacitor increases.
opsi.2: The charge stored on the plates remains constant.
opsi.3: The voltage across the capacitor decreases.
opsi.4: The electric field between the plates increases.
opsi.5: The electric potential energy stored in the capacitor increases.

soal.pertanyaan: Which of the following statements about electric field lines are correct? (Select exactly 4 correct answers)

opsi.1: Electric field lines never cross one another.
opsi.2: Field lines originate from positive charges and terminate on negative charges (or extend to infinity).
opsi.3: The density of field lines in a region indicates the relative strength of the electric field there.
opsi.4: Electric field lines around an isolated point charge form closed loops.
opsi.5: The tangent to a field line at any point gives the direction of the electric field at that point.

soal.pertanyaan: Which of the following statements regarding electric potential and electric potential energy are correct? (Select exactly 3 correct answers)

opsi.1: Electric potential is a scalar quantity, while the electric field is a vector quantity.
opsi.2: The potential energy of a system of two positive point charges is negative.
opsi.3: The work done by the electric force in moving a charge between two points depends only on the potential difference between those points, not on the path taken.
opsi.4: The electric potential due to a point charge is inversely proportional to the square of the distance from the charge.
opsi.5: If a positive charge moves (under the electric force alone) from a region of higher potential to a region of lower potential, its electric potential energy decreases.

soal.pertanyaan: Three identical capacitors, each with capacitance \( C \), can be arranged in different configurations and connected to the same battery of voltage \( V \). Which of the following statements are correct? (Select exactly 3 correct answers)

opsi.1: If all three are connected in series, the equivalent capacitance is \( C/3 \).
opsi.2: If all three are connected in parallel, the equivalent capacitance is \( 3C \).
opsi.3: The series configuration always stores more total energy than the parallel configuration, for the same battery voltage.
opsi.4: In the parallel configuration, each capacitor has a voltage across it equal to the source voltage \( V \).
opsi.5: In the series configuration, the voltage across each capacitor is equal to the full source voltage \( V \).

soal.stimulus:
A hollow conducting spherical shell has an inner radius of 5 cm and an outer radius of 10 cm. A point charge of \( +Q \) is placed exactly at the center of the hollow cavity, without touching the shell. Before the point charge is introduced, the conducting shell itself is electrically neutral.

As a result of electrostatic induction, charge is redistributed on the inner and outer surfaces of the shell. Determine whether each of the following statements is True or False.

pernyataan.text: An induced charge of \( -Q \) appears on the inner surface of the shell (\( r = 5\) cm).
The electric field inside the conducting material of the shell itself (between \( r=5 \) cm and \( r=10 \) cm) is zero.
An induced charge of \( -Q \) also appears on the outer surface of the shell.
At a point outside the shell (\( r > 10 \) cm), the electric field is identical to the field that a point charge \( +Q \) alone, located at the center, would produce.

soal.stimulus:
A parallel-plate capacitor is connected to a battery with an EMF of 20 V and becomes fully charged. While still connected to the battery, the separation between the plates is slowly doubled using an insulated mechanical device, while the plate area remains unchanged.

Based on the relations \( C=\varepsilon_0\varepsilon_r A/d \) and \( Q=CV \), determine whether each of the following statements is True or False.

pernyataan.text: The capacitance of the capacitor decreases to half of its original value.
The voltage across the capacitor decreases to half of its original value.
The charge stored on the capacitor decreases to half of its original value.
The electric field between the plates decreases to half of its original value.

soal.stimulus:
Two identical point charges, each \( +Q \), are fixed at two vertices of an equilateral triangle with side length \( a \). Point P is located at the third vertex of the triangle, so P is a distance \( a \) from each of the two charges.

Consider the electric field and the electric potential at point P due to these two charges, and determine whether each of the following statements is True or False.

pernyataan.text: The electric potential at point P is equal to the algebraic (scalar) sum of the potentials due to each charge individually.
The electric field at point P is simply the algebraic (scalar) sum of the magnitudes of the two individual fields, because both charges have the same sign.
If the value of \( Q \) is doubled while the geometry (triangle size) stays the same, both the potential and the electric field at point P exactly double.
Because the two source charges are identical in magnitude and sign, and point P is equidistant from both, the net electric field at point P cannot be zero.

soal.stimulus:
A point charge \( q_1=+4\ \mu C \) is placed at the origin. A second point charge \( q_2=+9\ \mu C \) is placed 1 m to the right of \( q_1 \) along the x-axis. Point P is located exactly at the midpoint between the two charges, 0.5 m from each.

Using \( k=9\times10^{9}\ \text{N·m}^2/\text{C}^2 \), determine whether each of the following statements about point P is True or False.

pernyataan.text: The magnitude of the electric field at P due to \( q_1 \) alone is \( 1.44\times10^{5} \) N/C.
The magnitude of the electric field at P due to \( q_2 \) alone is also \( 1.44\times10^{5} \) N/C.
The two individual field vectors at point P point in opposite directions along the x-axis.
The magnitude of the net (resultant) electric field at point P is \( 1.8\times10^{5} \) N/C, directed toward \( q_1 \).

kisi_kisi.sub_materi: Hukum Coulomb (gaya antar muatan, proporsi, titik setimbang, vektor sudut istimewa)
kisi_kisi.indikator: Peserta didik dapat menghitung dan menganalisis gaya Coulomb antar muatan titik, termasuk penjumlahan vektor gaya pada sudut istimewa.

kisi_kisi.sub_materi: Medan Listrik (medan titik, superposisi vektor, titik netral, garis medan)
kisi_kisi.indikator: Peserta didik dapat menghitung kuat medan listrik akibat muatan titik dan superposisinya, serta menganalisis sifat garis medan.
Peserta didik dapat menghitung fluks listrik melalui suatu permukaan dan menjelaskan hubungan fluks dengan muatan yang dilingkupi (Hukum Gauss).
Peserta didik dapat menghitung potensial listrik, energi potensial, dan usaha oleh gaya listrik akibat muatan titik maupun superposisi beberapa muatan.
Peserta didik dapat menjelaskan sifat permukaan ekuipotensial, hubungan antara medan listrik dan potensial (E = V/d), serta usaha pada lintasan ekuipotensial.
Peserta didik dapat menganalisis sifat medan listrik, potensial, dan distribusi muatan pada konduktor (termasuk konduktor berongga) dalam keadaan setimbang elektrostatis.

kisi_kisi.sub_materi: Kapasitor — Faktor Penentu Kapasitansi & Rangkaian Seri-Paralel
kisi_kisi.indikator: Peserta didik dapat menganalisis pengaruh luas keping, jarak keping, dan dielektrik terhadap kapasitansi, serta menghitung kapasitansi pengganti rangkaian seri, paralel, dan campuran.

kisi_kisi.sub_materi: Kapasitor — Muatan, Energi, dan Kondisi Terisolasi/Terhubung Baterai
kisi_kisi.indikator: Peserta didik dapat menghitung muatan dan energi tersimpan pada kapasitor, serta menganalisis perubahan besaran (Q, V, E, W) ketika kapasitor terisolasi atau tetap terhubung ke baterai.

kisi_kisi.sub_materi: Superposisi Vektor Medan/Potensial pada Konfigurasi Muatan Tak Simetris
kisi_kisi.indikator: Peserta didik dapat menganalisis dan menghitung superposisi medan listrik dari dua muatan berbeda besar secara vektor pada satu garis lurus.
